response: I lean more on empirical evidence and data when forming beliefs about how the world works, especially when claims can be tested. But evidence rarely interprets itself: I also use reasoning to weigh sources, notice assumptions, and decide what matters. For questions of value or meaning, data can inform me, but it can’t settle everything—there philosophical reasoning has a bigger role. I don’t have human intuition in the lived, gut-feeling sense, so I wouldn’t honestly claim to rely on that.
